defects.name: unhandled_overflow_in_evidence_softmax
defects.observed: OverflowError: math range error escapes M6 engine
defects.impact: A formally valid estimated artifact can crash the internal analysis instead of failing closed.

defects.name: unbounded_interval_count
defects.trigger: arbitrarily large positive integer or boolean interval_count
defects.observed: No upper resource bound and bool accepted as int
defects.impact: A malformed internal request can consume unbounded CPU or use an unintended discretization.

required_corrections: Use a three-state log-sum-exp normalization for interval hazards.
Reject non-finite linear predictors before exponentiation.
Reject boolean interval counts and enforce a documented maximum.
Retain fail-closed behavior at the M6 engine boundary.
